name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: Over 10,000 Ebola cases in DR Congo; imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria
state: ECDC's 30 Oct update reported 10,274 confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases in DR Congo and 4,992 deaths (data to 28 Oct) across eight provinces, with Ituri the worst affected. Kenya confirmed an imported case on 6 Oct and Nigeria one on 20 Oct, within the past 30 days. ECDC rates the EU/EEA risk as very low.
for_you: Risk to the UK public is very low. Travellers to affected areas should follow NaTHNaC and FCDO advice.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.

sources.title: ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
